doc.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

title: Living in Los Angeles for his family
summary: He lives in LA because his wife and daughter like it, though he misses his large family back east.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Yeah. On the way over you were talking about living in LA.
I knew you was going to bring that up. What did you run out of questions, interesting questions?
No I was interested because you know, like you said you’re a pretty honest guy, and I said do you like living in LA and you said, no.
Everybody there knows it too. So it’s no big deal.
Because my wife and daughter like it.
That’s the reason. They like it and they ain’t going nowhere. So, and I’m their puppy. So I’m not going nowhere.
If you could call your shots, if you could live anywhere you wanted to and work anywhere you wanted to, where would it be?
Well I do work all over the place, you know what I mean? I work all over. But you mean like living in a place?

It doesn’t really make any difference where you live, you know. And LA has enough talented guys out there, monsters, that you know you can get something happening. It’s just the other way of life. You know I’ve got a huge family back east and I’d like to be around them. And LA’s not a family-oriented town. So I kind of miss that.
